subject.title: Request: Add Discord reaction event support to Hooks system

question: Should OpenClaw add generic observation-only reaction_added/reaction_removed hooks to the public plugin API now, and should the first implementation be Discord-only or cross-channel?
rationale: Source inspection confirms the gap, but the permanent hook names, payload shape, enrichment model, filters, and channel scope are public Plugin SDK compatibility decisions.

options.title: Approve generic observation hooks
options.body: Define reaction_added/reaction_removed as portable plugin hooks and implement Discord first with a documented payload and authorization-preserving tests.

options.title: Scope Discord first
options.body: Add a Discord-specific hook or payload variant now, accepting a follow-up to reconcile cross-channel reaction semantics later.

options.title: Defer hook surface
options.body: Keep reactions as system events only and leave plugin reaction automation blocked until a broader inbound event API is designed.

recommendation.title: Approve generic observation hooks
recommendation.body: Define reaction_added/reaction_removed as portable plugin hooks and implement Discord first with a documented payload and authorization-preserving tests.

likelyOwner.reason: The most direct history signal is recent work on the public plugin hook contract files that would own the API shape.
